name: Recreation Aide and Pool Guard (City of San Diego Aquatics)
org: City of San Diego Parks and Recreation, Aquatics
what_you_do: Work at city pools. Recreation Aides provide customer service to the aquatics community while training to be a lifeguard. Pool Guards need no certification.
who_can_apply: Recreation Aide: at least 15 and a half years old. Pool Guard: at least 16 at the time of application, no certification needed.
pay_detail: Hourly pay is not stated on the page; see the posting on governmentjobs.com.
duration: Flexible hours that work around school and sports
deadline_text: Year-round hiring. Pool Guard hiring events are monthly; Recreation Aide interviews are quarterly.
how_to_apply: Apply for 'Recreation Aide' or 'Pool Guard 1' on the City's governmentjobs.com portal. The City then sends interview and skills-test details.
notes: The page does not say whether a work permit is needed; ask the City when you apply.
